dedupe_keys.name: exiobase 3 multi regional environmentally extended supply use and input output tables

description: EXIOBASE is a global, detailed multi-regional environmentally extended supply-use table and input-output table, built by harmonising and detailing national supply-use tables, estimating emissions and resource extraction by industry, and linking countries through trade, to analyse the environmental impacts of final consumption. EXIOBASE 3, one of the most extensive such systems, uses rectangular supply-use tables with 163 industries by 200 products. The monetary version is now updated on Zenodo (record 15689391, version 3.9.6 of 18 June 2025), with yearly industry-by-industry and product-by-product input-output tables from 1995 to 2022 as zipped files, and concordance tables are shared separately. EXIOBASE 3 is licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0 and free to download. The website also hosts earlier results such as the booklet on the global resource footprint of nations computed with EXIOBASE 2.1. Caveats: recent years are nowcast from partial data, and the country detail covers the major economies with rest-of-world regions for the others. For simulation it supplies the inter-industry and trade network with material, energy and emission extensions for supply-chain disruption, cascading economic loss and environmental footprint models. Related catalogue records include the World Input-Output Database, Eora2 and pymrio, a Python package that reads EXIOBASE.
